steps.comment: SpeedLM is a drop-in for vLLM. The whole launch, verbatim:
You wrote 'vllm serve MODEL'. Now: 'speedlm vllm serve MODEL'.
Every other flag is stock vLLM. The new one: --enable-idle-tuning.
That command is running right now, on a real GPU node:
Before the cycle: real captured traffic, no trained draft yet.
steps.command: echo "traces      $(wc -l < $H/traces/traces.jsonl) captured records"; echo "tuner state $(jq -r '.state+"  ("+.reason+")"' $H/runs/state.json 2>/dev/null || echo 'starting up')"; echo "draft head  $(jq -r .artifact_id $H/runs/active.json 2>/dev/null || echo 'none - serving the stock Eagle3 head')"

steps.comment: A plain vLLM server would now sit idle doing nothing. Watch this.
Live phase machine. It arms itself when traffic stops.
vLLM is asleep. The GPU is now training a real Eagle3 head.
Real optimizer steps, streaming out of the trainer as they happen:
steps.command: timeout 340 bash -c 'until S=$(ls $H/runs/*/training-logs/stdout.log 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$S" ]; do sleep 2; done; exec tail -F -n +1 $S' | awk 'match($0,/train.loss=[0-9.]+/){L=substr($0,RSTART+11,RLENGTH-11)} match($0,/global_step=[0-9]+/){N=substr($0,RSTART+12,RLENGTH-12)+0; if(N%3==0){printf "  step %-3d  train/loss = %s\n",N,L;fflush()}} match($0,/val.loss_epoch=[0-9.]+/){E++;printf "EPOCH %d done   val/loss_epoch = %s\n",E,substr($0,RSTART+15,RLENGTH-15);fflush();if(E==3)exit}'

steps.comment: Loss fell for real. Does the new head actually serve faster?
Back to the live phase machine for the benchmark and the gate:
The whole arc, with the real wall time each phase took:
steps.command: CAND=$(dirname $(ls $H/runs/*/decision.json | head -1)); jq -r '[.timestamp,(.from//"START"),.to,.reason]|@tsv' $H/runs/events.jsonl | awk -F'\t' 'NR==1{t0=$1;p=$1} {d=$1-p;p=$1;printf "%-18s -> %-18s %7.1fs  %s\n",$2,$3,d,substr($4,1,42)} END{printf "%-18s    %-18s %7.1fs  %s\n","","TOTAL",$1-t0,"wall clock"}'

steps.comment: The training loss the run wrote to disk, start to finish:
steps.command: awk 'match($0,/train.loss=[0-9.]+/){L=substr($0,RSTART+11,RLENGTH-11)} match($0,/global_step=[0-9]+/){N=substr($0,RSTART+12,RLENGTH-12)+0; if(N%3==0)printf "  step %-3d  train/loss = %s\n",N,L} match($0,/val.loss_epoch=[0-9.]+/){E++;printf "EPOCH %d done   val/loss_epoch = %s\n",E,substr($0,RSTART+15,RLENGTH-15)}' $CAND/training-logs/stdout.log

steps.comment: Held-out validation metrics for that head:
The gate verdict -- benchmarked against the stock head:
steps.command: jq -r 'def r2:(.*100|round/100); def r3:(.*1000|round/1000); def p(n):(tostring+"              ")[0:n]; "VERDICT              \(.verdict|ascii_upcase)   (\(.reason))", "criterion            \(.acceptance_criterion)", "", "                     \("candidate"|p(12))\("stock"|p(11))\("delta"|p(11))threshold", "accepted length      \(.candidate_avg_accepted_length|r3|p(12))\(.stock_avg_accepted_length|r3|p(11))\("\(.accepted_length_delta|r3)"|p(11))>= \(.min_accepted_length_delta)", "acceptance rate      \(.candidate_avg_acceptance|r3|p(12))\(.stock_avg_acceptance|r3|p(11))\("\(.acceptance_delta_pp|r2)pp"|p(11))>= \(.min_acceptance_delta_pp)pp", "tok/s (replay)       \(.candidate_avg_tok_per_sec|r2|p(12))\(.stock_avg_tok_per_sec|r2|p(11))\("\(.throughput_delta_pct|r2)%"|p(11))>= \(.min_throughput_delta_pct)%", "tok/s (prometheus)   \(.candidate_prometheus_decode_tok_per_sec|r2|p(12))\(.stock_prometheus_decode_tok_per_sec|r2|p(11))\("\(.prometheus_throughput_delta_pct|r2)%"|p(11))", "", "suite                \(.num_contexts) contexts x \(.num_repeats) repeats, max_tokens=\(.benchmark_max_tokens)", "output divergences   \(.output_total_divergences)/\(.divergence_trials)  (p=\(.divergence_total_p_value|r3))", "stock draft          \(.stock_draft)"' $CAND/decision.json | cut -c1-99

steps.comment: One idle window. No traffic lost, no operator. A faster server.
